findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If the input 'id' is exactly 2 characters long, the strncpy will copy 2 characters, and the explicit null termination will overwrite the last character of the _id array, leading to a buffer overflow.
findings.assumptions: The input 'id' is expected to be exactly 2 characters long, but the code does not enforce this. The _id array is declared with a size of 3, which includes the null terminator.
